title: HOMELESSNESS AND HEALTH COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a report on Los Angeles County Departments of Public Health, Mental Health, Health Services, and Social…
text:
[Council File 26-1412]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOMELESSNESS AND HEALTH COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a report on Los Angeles County Departments of Public Health, Mental Health, Health Services, and Social Services homelessness programs that support City residents.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Jurado – Blumenfield):
1. DIRECT the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA) to collaborate with the Los Angeles County Department of Public Health, the Department of Mental Health, the Department of Health Services, and the Department of Social Services, to report within 60 days on:
a. All homelessness programs that each County department funds to support City residents and their funding source.
b. The total number of staff assigned to each homelessness program that supports City residents.
c. The frequency of physical visits by County department staff to interim housing sites or Inside Safe sites located in the City.
d. The total number of calls that each County department receives requesting homelessness services within the City limits.
e. The County's process for prioritizing the City of Los Angeles' request for service, including criteria for prioritization and response mechanisms.
2. INSTRUCT the CLA to include in the report recommendations on potential mechanisms and methods that the City could use to more effectively engage with these departments.
Financial policies Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis statement of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion asking for a report on the homelessness programs that the County's public health, mental health, health services and social services departments run for City residents.
